maddeler.e:
أحتضر (form VIII)
# أَحْتَضِرُ (ʔaḥtaḍiru) /ʔaħ.ta.dˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# أُحْتَضَرُ (ʔuḥtaḍaru) /ʔuħ.ta.dˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# أَحْتَضِرَ (ʔaḥtaḍira) /ʔaħ.ta.dˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# أُحْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
